answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 1391 Country: India Title: What is your openion about covering head while offering salah? Tell the supporting Quarnic verses and ahadeeth and seerath? Question: What is your openion about covering head while offering salah? Tell the supporting Quarnic verses and ahadeeth and seerath? Answer ID: 1391 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 397/397=L) It is makrooh (undesirable) to perform salah bareheaded. Yet, if anyone sometimes prays bareheaded out of humility then it is allowed: وصلاتہ حاسراً ای کاشفاً رأسہ للتکاسل و لابأس بہ للتذلل (الدر المختار مع الشامی: 2/407) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
